ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are three regular hexagons side by side in the figure. In the regular hexagon on the left, the white part is a large triangle, with vertices respectively at the leftmost end, upper-right end, and lower-right end of the hexagon, and the gray region is the complement of this large triangle. The regular hexagon in the middle is divided into 6 congruent small equilateral triangles, among which 3 small triangles are shaded gray. In the regular hexagon on the right, the gray part is exactly the large triangle formed by the three vertices at the leftmost end, upper-right end, and lower-right end. Reasoning: A regular hexagon can be divided into 6 congruent equilateral triangles. The area of the large triangle formed by the leftmost end, upper-right end, and lower-right end is equal to half the area of the whole regular hexagon. Therefore, the gray region in the left figure is the complement of this large triangle, and also occupies half the area of the regular hexagon, so X is half the area of the hexagon; in the middle figure, 3 of the 6 congruent small triangles are shaded gray, so Y is also half the area of the hexagon; the gray large triangle itself in the right figure occupies half the area of the regular hexagon, so Z is also half the area of the hexagon. Therefore, the three gray areas X, Y, and Z are equal.

raw_record.question_text: In the three regular hexagons shown, what is the relationship among the areas $X$, $Y$, and $Z$ of the grey shaded parts?

method.method_draft: First read the image: the left hexagon has the grey region as the complement of the large triangle whose vertices are the leftmost vertex and the two upper/lower right vertices; the middle hexagon is divided into 6 congruent small equilateral triangles with exactly 3 shaded; the right hexagon has that same large triangle shaded. Read from the text that X, Y, and Z are the grey shaded areas in the three regular hexagons. Use the regular-hexagon area rule: a regular hexagon can be divided into 6 congruent equilateral triangles, and the triangle formed by the leftmost vertex and the two right-side nonadjacent vertices has area equal to half the hexagon. Thus in the left figure the shaded complement is half the hexagon, in the middle figure 3 of 6 equal triangles are shaded, and in the right figure the large shaded triangle is half the hexagon. Therefore X=Y=Z.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三个并排的正六边形。左边的正六边形中，白色部分是一个大三角形，顶点分别在六边形的最左端、右上端和右下端，灰色区域是这个大三角形的补集。中间的正六边形被分成6个全等的小等边三角形，其中有3个小三角形被涂灰。右边的正六边形中，灰色部分正是由最左端、右上端和右下端三个顶点组成的大三角形。
推理：正六边形可以分成6个全等的等边三角形。由最左端、右上端和右下端构成的大三角形面积等于整个正六边形面积的一半。因此，左图的灰色区域是该大三角形的补集，也占正六边形面积的一半，所以 X 是半个六边形面积；中图有6个全等小三角形中的3个被涂灰，所以 Y 也是半个六边形面积；右图灰色大三角形本身占正六边形面积的一半，所以 Z 也是半个六边形面积。因此 X、Y、Z 三个灰色面积相等。
